objective: Build compact evidence-grounded procedure cards from ExpeL successes, integrate into Planner, iterate until strong effectiveness is demonstrated.
mechanism: Typed evidence pivots: retrieve from target evidence backwards to available inputs, share prerequisites, and expose only bounded executable next steps to Planner. Five-field cards; source and schema checks stay outside prompts.
novelty_claim: System design hypothesis; no claim of literature-wide novelty.
construction: 237 raw ExpeL trajectories aligned by actual first user prompt; no test answers or test trajectories enter memory; every 10 completed cards reported to user.
baseline: Same production role workflow, provider/model, decoding, action budget and observation limits; Planner PM disabled, other LTM disabled in both arms.
development: Training-question samples and explicit capability probes. Debugging observations may inform iteration; record all runs and failures.
heldout: Freeze a stratified test subset before live testing. Do not tune on heldout failures; any reused set becomes development and must be replaced for final confirmation. Separately evaluate incident-excluded memory for generalization.
metrics: final answer correctness with ground-truth evaluation outside investigation
total API input/output tokens including retries

provisional_excellence_gates.correctness: At least 80% judged-correct on a frozen balanced set of >=40 tasks; report paired baseline, confidence intervals, and per-incident results.
provisional_excellence_gates.efficiency: No more than 10% increase in mean total tokens versus paired baseline; report tokens per correct answer and failures as well.
provisional_excellence_gates.reliability: At least 95% workflow completion without protocol/transport failure and <=5% invalid SQL on that set.
provisional_excellence_gates.grounding: Every shipped card has inspectable train sources, verified schema dependencies, and no case-specific answers; no fabricated evidence in inspected runs.
provisional_excellence_gates.generalization: Incident-excluded evaluation must show usefulness beyond memorizing one incident; insufficient evidence keeps the goal active.

notes: These are explicit working acceptance targets, not observed results or a guarantee. Any changed criterion must be justified and reported, never silently lowered to pass.
